findings.finding: The design avoids cross-request JVM and classloader reset claims. A generation accepts exactly one VALIDATE frame; READY is public startup evidence, never CLEAN or image-safety authority. Continuous sole-reader STARTUP/IDLE/REQUEST phases, lifetime stderr bounds, nonce/image matching, input closure, complete response staging and owned cleanup prevent a successful response from bypassing the terminal fences. The staged-result lease keeps public envelope construction inside the operation permit and moves the actual final installed-build/Alloy, cancellation and deadline checks to the publication method. This addresses cancellation after staging or after an earlier fence without claiming that bytes already published can be retracted.
